verses.1: In the sixth year of King Belashazar’s reign, I appeared before him. I am Daniel. I appeared to him at the beginning.
verses.2: And I will see in vision; and when I see, I am in the capital city that lies at the top of the country. And I will see in vision, and I will be on Uvali Oliy.
verses.3: And I opened my eyes and saw that there was one eagle standing in front of the altar. It had two wings, and those wings were raised high. One wing was higher than the other.
verses.4: I saw the sea boiling, swollen and turbulent. All living things refused to stand before it. No one could escape its wrath. It did whatever it wanted.
verses.5: And I understood that the trumpet of wrath was coming from the heavens, over all the land. There was no place where it could not reach. The trumpet of judgment was a sign of judgment among their eyes.
verses.6: And he came to the lake, where I saw the man with the horns. He rushed towards it with all his strength.
verses.7: And when he saw that the fish was approaching, he laughed at it. Then he broke off two of its fins. The fish no longer had the strength to stand before him. So he threw it aside onto the ground. It couldn’t be saved by anyone’s hands.
verses.8: And the pillar of the giants grew extremely large. And like its own shadow, it became a great structure. Its four branches extended towards the four winds of the sky.
verses.9: And from one of them came a young ray of light. It grew larger and larger, until it reached the north, the south, and the west.
verses.10: And it rose high up to the heavens. It tumbled the earth from among the stars and the planets.
verses.11: And until the leader of the congregation was raised up, from him the constant turmoil was caused, and he was cast out from his place of holiness.
verses.12: And God will give them punishment for their sins forever. Truth will be cast out from the land, and they will fail in their efforts.
verses.13: And I heard one Holy One speaking. He said to the Philmontians, “Until my death, let there be a constant vigilance against sin and impurity. And let there be holiness and righteousness among them.”
verses.14: And he said to me, “Until evening tomorrow, there will be one hundred and three thousand people. And the sacred day will come true.”
verses.15: And in my vision, I saw Daniel standing before me. I looked at him closely, and there he was, standing opposite me, looking like a giant.
verses.16: And I heard the voice of a man among them. He cried out, “Gabriel, son of God, please show me what is hidden.”
verses.17: And he came before me. As he entered, I was terrified and my face turned dark. He said to me, “Son of man, in the time of the end, these things will happen.”
verses.18: And in his words, I fell to the ground with my face covered. He touched me and made me stand up again.
verses.19: And he said, “I will tell you what will happen in the future of that war. It’s all predestined.”
verses.20: The eagle that you saw with the king of the eagles, Mada, and Pares.
verses.21: And the young sapling was king of Yavan; and the tall thorn bush, which stood between his eyes, was the first king.
verses.22: And the woman stood there, with four legs beneath her. She stood among the kings of the nations, but not by her own strength.
verses.23: And later, during their reigns, as they became wicked people, a king with a cruel face would rise to power. He would also be able to understand the mysteries of the world.
verses.24: And he used his strength, not just his power. His glory destroyed and succeeded in what he did. He destroyed those who were powerful and holy people.
verses.25: And with his wisdom and the skill he has in deceiving others, he will prosper. But with his arrogance, he will destroy many people. And he will stand among those who are powerful, but his hands will be broken.
verses.26: And in the morning and in the evening, when it is said that it is true, then you and I are also witnesses. For many days to come.
verses.27: And I will become a king, and I will rule for many days. I will do what is right for the king, and I will make him look great in front of others. But no one can understand me.
